cases.title: 配置文件写入明文密码
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/settings.py b/app/settings.py
--- a/app/settings.py
+++ b/app/settings.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 import os
 
+PASSWORD = "hunter2-demo"

known_bugs.description: 明文密码会随源码进入仓库。

cases.title: 解析错误被静默吞掉
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/parser.py b/app/parser.py
--- a/app/parser.py
+++ b/app/parser.py
@@ -1,2 +1,5 @@
 def parse(value):
-    return int(value)
+    try:
+        return int(value)
+    except Exception:
+        pass

known_bugs.description: 异常被吞掉，调用方无法区分成功和失败。

cases.title: 使用 eval 执行用户输入
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/expression.py b/app/expression.py
--- a/app/expression.py
+++ b/app/expression.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def evaluate(user_input):
+    return eval(user_input)

known_bugs.description: 攻击者可以提交任意 Python 表达式。

cases.title: SQL 使用字符串拼接
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/users.py b/app/users.py
--- a/app/users.py
+++ b/app/users.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def find_user(cursor, user_id):
+    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=" + user_id)

known_bugs.description: 用户输入直接进入 SQL，应使用参数化查询。

cases.title: 生产路径残留调试输出
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/store.py b/app/store.py
--- a/app/store.py
+++ b/app/store.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def save(item):
     db.save(item)
+    print("saved", item)

known_bugs.description: 调试输出绕过日志级别和脱敏流程。

cases.title: 直接索引请求参数
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/http.py b/app/http.py
--- a/app/http.py
+++ b/app/http.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def load_user(request):
+    user_id = request.args["user_id"]

known_bugs.description: 缺少参数时直接抛出未处理异常。

cases.title: 以 shell 模式执行命令
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/runner.py b/app/runner.py
--- a/app/runner.py
+++ b/app/runner.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def run(command):
+    subprocess.run(command, shell=True)

known_bugs.description: 命令字符串可能被 shell 解释为额外指令。

cases.title: 循环内逐条查询数据库
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/user_list.py b/app/user_list.py
--- a/app/user_list.py
+++ b/app/user_list.py
@@ -1,1 +1,3 @@
 def load_users(db, user_ids):
+    for user_id in user_ids:
+        user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()

known_bugs.description: 循环内执行查询，请求数会随数据量线性增长。

cases.title: 从环境变量读取密码
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/settings.py b/app/settings.py
--- a/app/settings.py
+++ b/app/settings.py
@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@
 import os
+PASSWORD = os.environ["APP_PASSWORD"]

cases.title: 使用参数化 SQL
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/users.py b/app/users.py
--- a/app/users.py
+++ b/app/users.py
@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@
 def find_user(cursor, user_id):
+    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))

cases.title: 使用安全的字面量解析
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/expression.py b/app/expression.py
--- a/app/expression.py
+++ b/app/expression.py
@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@
 def evaluate(user_input):
+    return ast.literal_eval(user_input)
